user.title: Sign in to ICA
user.description: Use the personnummer and password you sign in to ica.se with. If you only ever use BankID, set a password at ica.se first.

data_description.remember_password: Lets Home Assistant sign in again by itself if ICA ever logs it out. Without it, you'll be asked for the password then.

lists.title: Your ICA lists
lists.description: Signed in as {name}. Pick the lists to show in Home Assistant as to-do lists.

mirror.title: Mirror a list into ICA
mirror.description: Pick a Home Assistant to-do list, for example your Google Keep shopping list. Everything added there is added to the ICA list, renames and removals follow, and items you tick off in the ICA app are ticked off there too. Leave it empty to skip.

data.mirror_import: Also copy items added in the ICA app to the Home Assistant list

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ICA again
reauth_confirm.description: ICA needs the password for {account} again.

error.invalid_auth: ICA didn't accept that personnummer and password. BankID-only accounts need a password; set one at ica.se.
error.invalid_personnummer: That doesn't look like a personnummer (YYYYMMDD-XXXX).
error.geo_blocked: ICA only answers connections from Sweden. Is Home Assistant behind a VPN outside Sweden?
error.login_flow: ICA's sign-in answered something unexpected ({detail}). ICA may have changed it; check for an update of ICA Lists.
error.api_error: Signed in, but ICA wouldn't show the lists: {detail}
error.unknown: Unexpected error ({detail}). See the Home Assistant log.
error.mirror_self: Pick a list that isn't one of the ICA lists themselves.

abort.already_configured: This ICA account is already set up.

data.lists: ICA lists to show as to-do lists
data.mirror_source: Home Assistant list to mirror into ICA
data.mirror_import: Also copy items added in the ICA app to the Home Assistant list

error.mirror_self: Pick a list that isn't one of the ICA lists themselves.

abort.not_loaded: ICA Lists isn't running right now. Sort out the sign-in first, then try again.

geo_blocked.title: ICA is refusing Home Assistant's connection
geo_blocked.description: ICA only answers connections from Swedish IP addresses. If Home Assistant's traffic goes through a VPN or proxy outside Sweden, route ICA (ims.icagruppen.se and apimgw-pub.ica.se) around it.

mirror_list_missing.title: The ICA list to mirror into is gone
mirror_list_missing.description: {source} isn't being mirrored because the chosen ICA list no longer exists. Pick another one under ICA Lists → Configure.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Reads the ICA lists and runs the mirror right away.
